about: Source features that the evidence shows are wrong. 'exclude': they stay in the master dataset (flagged, confidence low) but are kept out of the game map; a feature is only excluded when independent evidence contradicts it. 'heights': storey counts and heights that reference photos contradict (the footprint is not touched). 'reclass': ground areas whose mapped use the reference photos and the owner contradict (the outline is kept).

exclude.reason: OSM building=yes + amenity=place_of_worship named 'lizalex' (8,486 m²) filling the strip between Elizabeth Sey Hall and Alexander Kwapong Hall. Google Open Buildings detects only small structures inside it and the Sentinel-2 composite shows open ground; no other source knows a church there. Treated as an erroneous edit.

heights.reason: The four Diaspora halls share one design: four storeys (ground + three) of rooms under a hipped tile roof, about 18 m to the ridge. Owner-supplied photos (aerial of all four halls, drone views of the facades and the entrance pavilion). OSM tags Limann building:levels=3; the others had no height and were estimated.
